findings: BLOCKING: The production API image does not build from 622fbf0. `docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile .` on a clean `git archive 622fbf0` fails in the build stage: packages/auth-fake/src/index.ts(46,8) TS2307 Cannot find module '@fxl-business/fxl-contracts/testing' (plus TS7006 at 601,34), so `pnpm --filter @fxl-sales/api build` exits 2. apps/api's tsc follows the dynamic import('@fxl-sales/auth-fake') in src/auth/select.ts into packages/auth-fake, whose node_modules are never installed because the deps stage copies only apps/api, shared-types and shared-utils package.json. Introduced by 430cc96 (430cc96^ builds, 430cc96 fails). Every local check (lint, type-check, tests, cold build) is green because the workspace has packages/auth-fake/node_modules; staging/production Docker deploys of v4.1.0 would fail before any migration runs.

Release notes: 'No new environment variable is introduced by v4.1.0' is literally false (SALES_LISTEN_HOST, SALES_AUTH_FAKE, SALES_ENV_FILE, VITE_AUTH_FAKE are new). None is required in staging/production; reword to 'no new required deployment variable' and mention SALES_LISTEN_HOST (defaults to every interface under NODE_ENV=production).

Release notes: the rollback section says v4.0.0 'ignores' the new tables and columns. It does not: v4.0.0 does not filter removed_at (soft-removed items/professionals reappear), its delete-and-recreate updateSale hits ON DELETE RESTRICT from sales_ops_settlements on any sale that ever had a baixa, and its paid toggles bypass the settlement ledger. State these consequences.
